item.title: Pinky Up, Houston: The Most Delightful Afternoon Tea Experiences in the City
item.description: Houston’s tea scene strikes a balance between old-school elegance and modern flair, offering everything from classic British-style spreads to imaginative, chef-driven interpretations. Before you book your table, it helps to know the difference between “high tea” and “afternoon tea”—two terms that get tossed around interchangeably, but aren’t quite the same.
